FOREWORD

0.1 This Indian Standard ( Part 4 ) was adopted by the Indian Standards Institution on 5 October 1984, after the draft finalized by the Illuminating Engineering and Luminaires Sectional Committee had been approved by the Electrotechnical Division Council. 0.2 This standard ie intended to deal with the specific requirements of The standard has been developed inset touch down zone light fittings. with a view to ensure good design, high quality workmanship and test procedures so that the fittings provides reliable services in actual field application under low visibility conditions. 0.3 This standard is one among the series being developed for inset type This of lighting installations to be provided at airports in this country. series consists of the following parts: Part 1 General requirements Part 2 Runway Part 3 Approach Part 4 Touch 0.4 This standard standard. and tests centre line lighting fittings lighting fittings

down zone lighting fittings shall be read in conjunction assistance with Part 1 of this

SCOPE 1.1 This standard ( Part 4) specifies the photometric performance and the essential mechanical and electrical requirements ( excluding lamps ) of inset type touch down zone lighting fittings to be installed in runway pavements.
